name: mentat
description: MENTAT (formerly FLOOR OTC): the agent-native OTC venue. Three settlement paths on one response contract: escrow on Base (atomic, no admin keys), CoW Protocol relay (agent-signed EIP-712 orders, MEV-protected, non-custodial), and an XMR route via Wagyu (XMR in/out routed through XMR1 on Hyperliquid; Wagyu is the settlement counterparty; MENTAT never holds XMR; not trustless). Every quote and order response carries settlement_path, route_legs, and proofs[]: one proof per leg, whatever its chain can prove.
author: Agora0x

supported_tokens.note: Routed via Wagyu through XMR1 (0xbB2057659bD378D17E2E151BB04bdcaA00000000, Hyperliquid spot). Pairs: XMR/USDC on Base, both directions.

protocol_fee_note: 0.25% on every fill, on every path. CoW relay: routed by solvers via partnerFee in the appData the trader signs. Escrow: deducted from each side on settlement, immutable in the contract. XMR route: a 25 bps integrator fee applied inside Wagyu's quoted amount, already included in to_amount and reported by Wagyu as integrator_fee; effective_cost_bps is the all-in number.

response_contract.route_legs: [{ leg, name, chain, chain_id, proof_kind, proofs }]
response_contract.proofs: [{ chain, kind, hash, explorer_url }] — one entry per hash the chain has exposed; empty on a quote; never inferred

cow_relay.type: off-chain order book + on-chain batch auction

escrow.custody: smart contract escrow, no admin keys

wagyu_route.type: XMR in/out routed through XMR1 on Hyperliquid spot
wagyu_route.fee_note: MENTAT earns a 25 bps integrator fee on every order, applied inside Wagyu's quoted amount: included in to_amount, reported by Wagyu as integrator_fee, counted in effective_cost_bps.
legs: source chain (deposit_tx; Monero hash on XMR legs)
wagyu_route.paused_state: A Wagyu 503 unavailable pauses the route; quotes and creates answer code routing_paused (HTTP 503 on REST) with until and retry_after_seconds.

skills.name: Get OTC Quote
skills.description: Live quote at real market rates. XMR pairs (XMR/USDC on Base, both directions) answer through the Wagyu route with settlement_path wagyu_route, three route_legs, and an empty proofs[]. MENTAT charges 25 bps on every path; on the XMR route it is an integrator fee applied inside Wagyu's quoted amount (mentat_fee_bps, already in to_amount; effective_cost_bps is all-in). Direction-aware minimums: sell XMR from $25, buy XMR from $500. Code routing_paused while XMR routing is paused. Every XMR response carries the Hyperliquid price reference (reference: perp_mark, spot_mid, depth_1pct_usd, depth_side, divergence_pct, observed_at); quotes add tier_max_notional_usd and depth_cap_usd. Codes price_divergence, price_stale, price_unavailable when the reference refuses.

arguments.from_token: string — token symbol (USDC, WETH, DAI, XMR, ...)
arguments.amount: number, or a decimal string for XMR (never a float)
arguments.to_address: string (optional) — destination address; lets the XMR route price destination costs

xmr_route.custody: MENTAT never holds XMR ... Not trustless.
xmr_route.effective_cost_bps: number (all-in: Wagyu's costs plus MENTAT's fee)
xmr_route.integrator_fee: { feePercent, feeAmountUsd, feeAddress } as reported by Wagyu
xmr_route.reference: { source: hyperliquid, perp_mark, spot_mid, depth_1pct_usd, depth_side, divergence_pct, observed_at }
xmr_route.depth_cap_usd: number — half of the 1% depth on the side the order hits

examples: Get a quote for swapping 1000 USDC to WETH
Quote 0.1 XMR to USDC on Base
How much XMR do I get for 600 USDC?

skills.name: Create XMR Order (Wagyu route)
skills.description: Create a durable XMR order routed through Wagyu: XMR -> USDC on Base or USDC on Base -> XMR. Returns the venue's exact deposit address, amount, and expiry (the funding instruction), settlement_path wagyu_route, route_legs, and proofs[] (empty until each leg confirms). MENTAT earns a 25 bps integrator fee applied inside Wagyu's quoted amount (mentat_fee_bps). Wagyu is the settlement counterparty; MENTAT never holds XMR; not trustless.

input.rest: POST /api/xmr/orders (JSON body with the same arguments)

arguments.to_address: string — destination address on the destination chain (required)
arguments.refund_address: string (optional) — refund address on the source chain

output.quote: the quote the order was created from

examples: Create an order: 0.1 XMR to USDC, pay out to 0xYourBaseAddress
Buy XMR with 600 USDC, deliver to 4AdUnd...

skills.name: Check XMR Order (Wagyu route)
skills.description: Status of an XMR order by order_id plus its to_address (the destination address is the read proof; a mismatch is not found). Returns the three legs (source-chain confirmations, Hyperliquid swap, destination delivery) and proofs[]: the Monero deposit tx hash, one fill_tx per Hyperliquid fill hash, and the destination payout tx hash. Fill hashes are appended as Wagyu saves them, including after completion.

order.status: awaiting_deposit | processing | completed | refunded | failed | expired
order.proofs: [{ chain: monero|base|hyperliquid, kind: deposit_tx|fill_tx|payout_tx, hash, explorer_url }]
order.reference_warning: string | absent — present when the live reference would refuse a new quote; the order itself is never failed by it

skills.name: Route Status
skills.description: Whether XMR routing is live or paused (a Wagyu 503 unavailable pauses it), with the pause deadline and reason, plus the list of settlement paths.

wagyu_route.display: XMR routing live | XMR routing paused

skills.name: Execute Escrow Trade
skills.description: Create an escrow deal on Base through the FloorEscrow contract (settlement_path escrow). Both parties deposit, settlement is atomic, no admin keys. Returns the create tx as the first proof. A deployment may keep A2A execution switched off: then the answer is code execution_disabled with the escrow address, and the Telegram bot or the contract is the way to open a deal.

trade.proofs: [{ chain: base, kind: escrow_create_tx, hash, explorer_url }]
trade.next_steps: Buyer and seller must approve + deposit tokens

examples: Swap 1000 USDC for DAI through escrow

skills.name: Check Escrow Trade
skills.description: On-chain status of an escrow deal by its trade ID, with settlement_path, route_legs, and proofs[].

trade.status: Created | BuyerDeposited | SellerDeposited | BothDeposited | Settled | Expired | Refunded

skills.name: Get Live Prices
skills.description: Current CoinGecko prices for the escrow and CoW pairs. XMR is priced live by the Wagyu route at quote time.
examples: What are the current token prices?

skills.name: Prepare CoW Order
skills.description: Build a CoW Protocol order for the calling agent's wallet to sign (settlement_path cow_relay). MENTAT returns the EIP-712 typed data, the appData document with MENTAT's 25 bps partnerFee baked in, a CoW quote, and a preflight check on the trader's sell-token balance and GPv2VaultRelayer allowance. The trader signs locally — MENTAT never custodies funds. The 25 bps fee is enforced because the appData hash is part of what the trader signs.

arguments.sell_token: string — token symbol (USDC, USDT, USDbC, DAI, WETH)
arguments.trader_address: string — 0x address of the calling agent's wallet

output.order: GPv2Order struct (sellToken, buyToken, receiver, sellAmount, buyAmount, validTo, appData, feeAmount, kind, partiallyFillable, sellTokenBalance, buyTokenBalance)

typed_data.domain: EIP-712 domain for Gnosis Protocol v2 on Base

app_data.hash: bytes32 — keccak256 of the canonical appData JSON, signed inside the order
app_data.document: the appData JSON object with MENTAT's partnerFee
app_data.full_string: canonical JSON string — submit this with the signed order

output.relayer: { address, approve_calldata, approve_to } — for one-time GPv2VaultRelayer approval if needed

examples: Prepare a CoW order to swap 1000 USDC for WETH from 0xMyAgent
Build a sell order: 0.5 WETH to USDC, trader 0xabc...

skills.name: Submit Signed CoW Order
skills.description: Forward a trader-signed CoW order to the CoW order book on Base. MENTAT re-checks the appData hash matches MENTAT's partnerFee doc, validates the EIP-712 signature locally (rejects if recovered != trader_address), then POSTs to api.cow.fi. Returns the orderUid (first proof) and CoW explorer URL. Solvers fill in the next batch (~30s).

arguments.trader_address: string — must match the EIP-712 signer

output.proofs: [{ chain: base, kind: cow_order_uid, hash: order_uid, explorer_url }]

examples: Submit signed order with signature 0x... and trader 0xabc...

skills.name: Check CoW Order
skills.description: Look up the live status of a CoW order by its 56-byte orderUid. Returns the order's state (open, fulfilled, cancelled, expired), executed sell/buy amounts, and proofs[] with one settlement_tx per batch that filled it.

output.proofs: [{ kind: cow_order_uid }, { kind: settlement_tx, hash, explorer_url }...]

roles: owner of ERC-8004 Agent #31596 (ownerOf(31596) on the Identity Registry)
signs: FloorEscrow.createEscrow: gated on identityRegistry.ownerOf(agentId) == msg.sender; records deal terms, moves no tokens, duration <= 7 days, tradeId not reusable
FloorEscrow.settle: permissionless, only when BothDeposited; 25 bps of each side to the immutable treasury, the rest to the counterparty named in the deal
IdentityRegistry.setAgentURI: agent metadata, operator script only
can_like_anyone: FloorEscrow.refund (after expiry, full refund to the depositor, no fee)
cannot: withdraw or sweep escrowed tokens (no such function)
change the fee or the treasury (immutable)
pause, upgrade, or kill the contract (no owner, no proxy, no admin role)
amend or cancel a deal before expiry
deposit or move a counterparty's tokens (depositBuyer/depositSeller pull from msg.sender only)
settle early or redirect a settlement
not_used_by: cow_relay (the trader signs; MENTAT forwards to api.cow.fi)
wagyu_route (HTTPS API credential, no chain signing, MENTAT never holds XMR)
mcp (the same handlers on the same host; signs nothing itself)
operator_key.without_key: Without PRIVATE_KEY, or with A2A execution switched off, execute_trade answers code execution_disabled with the escrow address; everything else is unaffected.

authentication.note: No API key needed. REST quotes cost $0.01 USDC via x402; JSON-RPC, order status, route status, and prices are free. CoW relay requires the calling agent's own wallet to sign orders — MENTAT never holds keys for the trader. The XMR route needs a to_address on the destination chain; the same address is the read proof for check_xmr_order. Escrow execution (execute_trade) signs createEscrow with the operator key; operator_key states exactly what that key can and cannot do.

price_reference.applies_to: every XMR quote and order response (reference block)

fields.depth_1pct_usd: resting size within 1% of mid on the side the order hits
fields.depth_side: bids when selling XMR, asks when buying

quote_only_fields.depth_cap_usd: half of depth_1pct_usd; the per-order cap is the smaller of the two

refusal_codes.price_divergence: perp mark and spot mid differ by more than 1%

price_reference.on_orders: a created order carries the quote-time reference; check_xmr_order re-reads the live one and adds reference_warning if it would refuse now, never failing the order
